source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 6 (PDF 76-92), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Data and Analysis) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 List the steps of the data science workflow in order.
(Data science workflow ke qadam tarteeb se likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mukhtalif sources se data jama karna.
2. Data ko saaf (clean) aur munazzam karna.
3. Data ka analysis (tajziya) karna.
4. Nataij ki ehtiyat se tashreeh (interpretation) karna, taa ke data ilm ban kar asal masail hal kare.

book_ref.quote: It involves collecting data from different sources

blocks.prompt:
2 Why is data science called interdisciplinary? Name the fields it combines.
(Data science ko interdisciplinary kyun kehte hain? Jin fields ko yeh milati hai un ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Data science mukhtalif mazameen ka ilm milati hai, is liye interdisciplinary (kai shobon wali) hai. Yeh mathematics (adad aur hisaab), statistics (data ka tajziya aur khulasa), computer science (tools aur programming), domain knowledge (asal masail ki samajh) aur communication skills (nataij samjhana) ko jorti hai.

book_ref.quote: Data science combines knowledge from different subjects

blocks.prompt:
3 Give two ways in which data science helps in decision-making.
(Data science faisla karne mein kin do tareeqon se madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh haqaiq aur data se sawalon ke jawab deti hai, jis se faislon mein andaza (guesswork) kam hota hai.
2. Yeh mustaqbil ke trends predict karne mein madad karti hai. Yeh business, taleem aur healthcare mein aam hai.

book_ref.quote: It is widely used in business, education, and healthcare

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the role of mathematics and statistics in data science.
(Data science mein mathematics aur statistics ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mathematics adad aur hisaab ke kaam aati hai. Statistics data ka tajziya aur khulasa (summary) karne mein madad karti hai. Doosri fields ke saath mil kar yeh data analysis ko zyada mo'assar banati hain.

book_ref.quote: It uses mathematics to work with numbers and calculations

blocks.prompt:
5 Define data. Name any three forms in which data can exist.
(Data ki tareef karein. Data ki koi teen shaklein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Data kachay haqaiq aur values ka majmua hai jis se information (maloomat) banti hai; yeh data science ki bunyad hai. Yeh numbers, text, images, audio ya video ki shakal mein ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Data is the foundation of Data Science

blocks.prompt:
6 Why is understanding data important before analysis?
(Analysis se pehle data ko samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif qisam ke data ko mukhtalif tareeqe se sambhalna parta hai. Sahi samajh durust nataij deti hai, jab ke ghalat samajh errors (ghaltiyan) paida karti hai. Durust nataij ke liye data durust aur qabil-e-bharosa hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Data must be accurate and reliable to produce accurate results

blocks.prompt:
7 Give two examples each of structured and unstructured data.
(Structured aur unstructured data ki do do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Structured data: students ki mark sheets, databases.
Unstructured data: emails, images (audio aur videos bhi).

book_ref.quote: It has rows and columns that are easy to understand

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is unstructured data harder to work with?
(Unstructured data ke saath kaam karna mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unstructured data ka koi muqarrar format nahi hota, is liye ise seedha analyze karna mushkil hai. Ise process karne ke liye khaas tools chahiye. Phir bhi jadeed systems dono qisam ka data istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Special tools are needed to process it

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between manual and automatic data collection.
(Manual aur automatic data collection mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: whereas automatic data collection uses machines and software

rows: Insani mehnat se hoti hai
Machines aur software se hoti hai
Misal: log surveys, interviews, forms bharte hain
Misal: sensors data record karte hain

blocks.prompt:
10 Name any three online or other sources of data. On what does the choice of method depend?
(Data ke koi teen sources likhein. Tareeqe ka intikhab kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sources: surveys, interviews, forms, sensors aur online platforms (blogs, social websites). Data real time mein ya waqt ke saath jama ho sakta hai; tareeqa analysis ke maqsad par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Data can be collected in real time or stored over time

blocks.prompt:
11 How do data sources affect the quality of analysis?
(Data sources analysis ki quality par kaise asar dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Achhe data sources aur durust data collection analysis ki quality behtar karte hain. Kharab data ghalat nataij ki taraf le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Good data sources and accurate data collections improve analysis quality

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between data storage and data management.
(Data storage aur data management mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Data storage refers to saving data for future use

rows: Data ko aaynda istemal ke liye mehfooz karna
Data ko munazzam rakhna aur sambhalna
Files, databases ya cloud systems mein
Data aasani se mile aur istemal ho
Sahi storage data ko zaya hone se bachati hai
Security aur backup shamil; lambay arse tak istemal

blocks.prompt:
13 Write two points that make data management effective.
(Data management ko mo'assar banane wali do baatein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Security (hifazat) data management ka ahem hissa hai.
2. Backup systems data zaya hone se bachate hain. Achhi tarah managed data efficiency barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Security is an important part of data management

blocks.prompt:
14 How does a machine learning system learn without predefined rules?
(Machine learning system pehle se tay rules ke baghair kaise seekhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle se tay rules ke bajaye yeh misalon se seekhta hai aur data mein patterns pehchanta hai jo predictions mein rehnumai karte hain. Zyada data process karne se yeh zyada durust aur efficient hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Instead of predefined rules, machine learning allows systems to learn from examples

blocks.prompt:
15 Write two benefits of machine learning in modern applications.
(Jadeed applications mein machine learning ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh automation aur intelligent (zaheen) systems mein madad karti hai.
2. Yeh smart applications chalati aur haath ka kaam kam karti hai; naya data aane par models waqt ke saath behtar hote hain.

book_ref.quote: which adapt and improve over time as new data is introduced

blocks.prompt:
16 What is meant by learning from data?
(Learning from data se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Learning from data ka matlab purani maloomat se faisle behtar karna hai. Data learning model ko input diya jata hai jo is ke taluqat dekhta hai; bar bar training se errors kam hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Learning from data means using past information to improve decisions

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between traditional programming and machine learning.
(Traditional programming aur machine learning mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: The system learns rules automatically from data

rows: Programmers ke likhe fixed rules
Fixed rules ke bajaye data
Output rules par chal kar banta hai
System data se khud rules seekhta hai
Tabdeeli ke liye naya code
Tabdeeli naye data se

blocks.prompt:
18 Give two advantages of machine learning over traditional programming.
(Traditional programming ke muqable mein machine learning ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Machine learning pecheeda (complex) masail behtar hal karti hai.
2. Yeh naye halaat ke mutabiq dhal jati hai, kyun ke tabdeeli naye code ke bajaye naye data se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Machine learning handles complex problems better

blocks.prompt:
19 What are machine learning mechanisms? Name the three kinds discussed.
(Machine learning mechanisms kya hain? Bayan ki gayi teen qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Machine learning mechanisms batate hain ke systems data se kaise seekhte hain; mukhtalif masail ke liye mukhtalif mechanisms hain. Teen qismein: supervised, unsupervised aur reinforcement machine learning.

book_ref.quote: Some methods use labeled data, while others do not

blocks.prompt:
20 Give two examples of labelled datasets used in supervised learning.
(Supervised learning mein istemal hone wale labelled datasets ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Spam ya not spam label wali emails.
2. Cat ya dog label wali images (aur normal ya abnormal label wale medical scans).

book_ref.quote: Supervised learning needs large labelled datasets

blocks.prompt:
21 Name four real applications of supervised learning.
(Supervised learning ki chaar asal applications ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Face recognition, disease detection, speech recognition aur fraud detection (recommendation systems bhi).

book_ref.quote: It is widely used in real applications, such as face recognition, disease detection

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between supervised and unsupervised learning.
(Supervised aur unsupervised learning mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: The system finds patterns without guidance

rows: Labeled data istemal karti hai
Unlabeled data par kaam karti hai
Har item ka input aur sahi output
Koi sahi output nahi diya jata
Apna output sahi jawab se mila kar seekhti hai
Baghair rehnumai patterns dhoondti hai; milta julta data clusters mein
Misal: email spam detection, exam result prediction
Misal: customer grouping, data clustering

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a cluster in unsupervised learning?
(Unsupervised learning mein cluster kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cluster milte julte data items ka group (guchha) hai. Unsupervised learning milte julte data ko ikattha karke clusters banati hai; learning data ki mushabihat par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Learning depends on data similarity

blocks.prompt:
24 Define reinforcement machine learning.
(Reinforcement machine learning ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Reinforcement machine learning tajurbe se seekhti hai aur insani seekhne ki naqal karti hai. System mahol (environment) se interact karta hai aur actions par rewards (inaam) ya penalties (saza) paata hai; maqsad rewards zyada karna hai.

book_ref.quote: Reinforcement machine learning learns through experience and mimics the human learning

blocks.prompt:
25 Give two examples of reinforcement learning.
(Reinforcement learning ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Rewards aur penalties se maze mein raasta seekhta robot.
2. Apni driving ke faisle behtar karti autonomous car (aur Go khel kar strategy behtar karta AlphaGo).

book_ref.quote: Examples of reinforcement learning include a robot learning to navigate a maze

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between supervised and reinforcement learning.
(Supervised aur reinforcement learning mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Positive rewards encourage correct behavior

rows: Sahi output wale labeled data se seekhti hai
Mahol se interact karke tajurbe se seekhti hai
Output sahi jawab se milati hai
Actions par rewards ya penalties paati hai
Prediction ke kaam
Robotics aur games

blocks.prompt:
27 How does machine learning help in healthcare? Give two examples.
(Healthcare mein machine learning kaise madad karti hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh medical data analyze karke bimari pakarne aur tashkhees (diagnosis) mein madad karti hai, taa ke doctors behtar aur waqt par ilaj plan karein. Misalein: medical images mein cancer cells pehchanna; Alzheimer's ya dementia ki ibtidai alamaat pehchanna.

book_ref.quote: Doctors can use these results to plan better and more timely treatments

blocks.prompt:
28 Write any two uses of machine learning in business.
(Business mein machine learning ke koi do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Financial systems mein fraud (dhoka) pakarna.
2. Robots ya chatbots se customer service (aur products suggest karna, sales predict karna, inventory management).

book_ref.quote: customer services through robots or chatbots, and suggesting products to customers

blocks.prompt:
29 How is machine learning used in education?
(Taleem mein machine learning kaise istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh students ki karkardagi track karke grades behtar karti hai, har student ke mutabiq content deti hai aur attendance aur assessment systems ko smart banati hai, jis se learning outcomes behtar hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It helps track students' performance to improve their grades

blocks.prompt:
30 Name four everyday applications of machine learning.
(Machine learning ki chaar rozmarra applications likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mobile phones mein face recognition, bolay gaye hukm samajhne wale voice assistants, email spam filter aur raastay batane wali navigation apps (video aur music recommendations bhi).

book_ref.quote: Voice assistants understand spoken commands

blocks.prompt:
31 Name four kinds of student data collected in the grade prediction example.
(Grade prediction ki misal mein jama kiye jane wale students ke data ki chaar qismein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Attendance, quiz marks, assignment scores aur study hours (aur pichhle exam ke nataij).

book_ref.quote: data about students is first collected, such as attendance, quiz marks, assignment scores

blocks.prompt:
32 Write the steps of building a machine learning model in the student grade prediction example.
(Student grade prediction ki misal mein machine learning model banane ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Students ka data jama karna.
2. Data saaf aur tayyar karna.
3. Ahem values (features) chunna.
4. Tayyar data par model train karna; phir yeh naye input se student ka mumkina grade batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Building a machine learning model involves several clear steps

blocks.prompt:
33 What does MSE stand for? What does a lower MSE show?
(MSE ka poora naam kya hai? Kam MSE kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: MSE ka matlab Mean Squared Error hai. Kam MSE behtar karkardagi dikhata hai kyun ke predicted values asal values ke qareeb hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: A lower MSE indicates better model performance because it means the predicted values are closer to the actual values

blocks.prompt:
34 In the hours-vs-scores program, what is the output after the print line is corrected to show the MSE to 4 decimal places and the model equation?
(Hours-vs-scores program mein print line durust karne ke baad (MSE 4 decimal tak aur model equation) output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Mean Squared Error: 0.1484
Model equation: Exam Score = 0.6552 × Hours Studied + 0.1466
(Book mein chhapa program sirf poora MSE 0.14840963139120109 dikhata hai.)

book_ref.quote: To get that output, write {mse:.4f} in the print line

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book wala program sirf aik line print karta hai. {mse:.4f} likhne se MSE 4 decimal tak aata hai, aur model.coef_[0] (slope) aur model.intercept_ print karne se equation wali doosri line aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
35 In the regression program, what is the purpose of model.fit() and model.predict()?
(Regression program mein model.fit() aur model.predict() ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: model.fit(X_train, y_train) linear regression model ko training data par train karta hai. model.predict(X_test) test data par predictions karta hai, jinhein y_test se mila kar MSE nikala jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The model is tested on the test data (X_test) and the mean squared error (MSE) is calculated

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between features and target values.
(Features aur target values mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Features must be relevant to the problem

rows: Model ki input values
Predict hone wale outputs
Masle se mutaliq hone chahiyein
Wazeh tor par tay hone chahiyein
Misal: study hours
Misal: marks

blocks.prompt:
37 Define feature engineering with an example.
(Feature engineering ki tareef misal ke saath karein.)
blocks.explanation: Feature engineering behtar learning ke liye data ko behtar banana hai: features chunna, badalna aur naye banana. Misal: marks ki prediction mein raw study hours ko saaf aur scale karna aur "study hours per day" jaisa naya feature banana.

book_ref.quote: Feature engineering means improving data for better learning

blocks.prompt:
38 Give two reasons why feature engineering is important.
(Feature engineering ahem kyun hai, do wajahen likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Raw data aksar models ke liye tayyar nahi hota; use cleaning aur scaling chahiye.
2. Achhe features ahem maloomat ubharte hain aur behtar predictions dete hain, jis se model mazboot hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Good features produce better predictions

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between training data and testing data.
(Training data aur testing data mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Training data teaches the model patterns

rows: Model ko patterns sikhata hai
Model ki karkardagi check karta hai
Jis se model seekhta hai
Na-dekha data, is liye asal karkardagi
Aam tor par 80 feesad
Aam tor par 20 feesad

blocks.prompt:
40 A dataset has 1200 records. Using the common split, how many records go to training and how many to testing?
(Aik dataset mein 1200 records hain. Aam split se kitne training aur kitne testing mein jayenge?)
blocks.explanation:
Aam split: 80 feesad training, 20 feesad testing.
Training = 1200 ka 80% = 960 records; testing = 1200 ka 20% = 240 records.

book_ref.quote: Data is divided into training and testing sets

blocks.prompt:
41 What is a simple predictive model? How is its performance measured?
(Simple predictive model kya hai? Is ki karkardagi kaise naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Simple predictive model bunyadi algorithms se training data se seekhta, patterns samajhta aur naye, na-dekhe data ke liye predictions karta hai. Is ki karkardagi test data se naapi jati hai aur nataij behtari ki rehnumai karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Their performance is measured using test data and the results guide improvements

blocks.prompt:
42 Define model evaluation. Why is it done on test data?
(Model evaluation ki tareef karein. Yeh test data par kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Model evaluation yeh jaanchne ka amal hai ke machine learning model kitna achha kaam karta hai. Is mein woh test data istemal hota hai jo training mein nahi tha, is liye yeh predictions ki asal quality aur model ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Model evaluation is a process of checking how well a machine learning model performs

blocks.prompt:
43 Why are precision and recall used along with accuracy?
(Accuracy ke saath precision aur recall kyun istemal kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada accuracy wala model bhi kuch cases mein ghalat nataij de sakta hai; sirf accuracy dhoka de sakti hai. Precision aur recall model ki asal karkardagi zyada wazeh dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: A model with high accuracy may still give wrong results in some cases

blocks.prompt:
44 What do TP, TN, FP and FN stand for?
(TP, TN, FP aur FN ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: TP (true positives): sahi predict hue positive. TN (true negatives): sahi predict hue negative. FP (false positives): ghalat tor par positive predict hue. FN (false negatives): ghalat tor par negative predict hue.

book_ref.quote: TP (True Positives): Number of correctly predicted positive instances.

blocks.prompt:
45 A model gives TP = 70, TN = 15, FP = 10 and FN = 5. Find its accuracy and error rate.
(Model ke TP = 70, TN = 15, FP = 10 aur FN = 5 hain. Accuracy aur error rate nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN) = (70 + 15) / 100 = 0.85 = 85%.
Error rate (accuracy ka ulat) = 100% - 85% = 15%.

book_ref.quote: Accuracy shows how many predictions are correct out of the total predictions

blocks.prompt:
46 Give two points about the use of accuracy in evaluation.
(Evaluation mein accuracy ke istemal ke baare mein do baatein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Zyada accuracy behtar karkardagi hai, magar sirf accuracy kabhi kabhi dhoka deti hai.
2. Balanced (mutawazin) data behtar accuracy nataij deta hai; error analysis ghaltiyan dhoondne mein madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Balanced data gives better accuracy results

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between precision and recall.
(Precision aur recall mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Recall focuses on completeness

rows: Positive predictions mein se kitni waqai sahi
Asal positive cases mein se kitne sahi pehchane gaye
Durusti (correctness) par zor
Mukammaliyat (completeness) par zor
Zyada precision ghalat nataij kam karta hai
Zyada recall miss hone wale cases kam karta hai
Precision = TP / (TP + FP)
Recall = TP / (TP + FN)

blocks.prompt:
48 A model gives TP = 24, FP = 6 and FN = 10. Find its precision and recall.
(Model ke TP = 24, FP = 6 aur FN = 10 hain. Precision aur recall nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Precision = TP / (TP + FP) = 24 / 30 = 0.8.
Recall = TP / (TP + FN) = 24 / 34 = 0.7059.

book_ref.quote: Precision measures how many predicted positive results are actually correct

blocks.prompt:
49 Write the equation of F1-score. Why is it useful?
(F1-score ki equation likhein. Yeh kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: F1-Score = 2 × (Precision × Recall) / (Precision + Recall). Yeh precision aur recall ko aik score mein mutawazin karta hai, unbalanced data mein mufeed hai aur sirf accuracy par bharosa karne se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: It gives a single performance score

blocks.prompt:
50 If precision = 0.8 and recall = 0.7059, find the F1-score.
(Agar precision = 0.8 aur recall = 0.7059 ho to F1-score nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: It balances correctness and completeness

blocks.prompt:
51 How does validation help in model improvement?
(Validation model ki behtari mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Model ki behtari validation ke nataij ke feedback se hoti hai: kamzor hisse pehchan kar durust kiye jate hain. Validation yeh bhi dikhati hai ke model ne data ratta (overfitting) to nahi, aur asal istemal se pehle munsifana jaanch karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Model improvement uses feedback from validation results

blocks.prompt:
52 What is a validation dataset? Write two of its requirements.
(Validation dataset kya hai? Is ki do sharaait likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Validation dataset training aur testing data se alag hota hai aur model ki karkardagi check karta hai; model is se nahi seekhta.
1. Yeh saaf aur durust ho taa ke asal halaat dikhaye.
2. Yeh balanced ho, kyun ke balanced data behtar nataij deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A validation dataset is separate from training and testing data that is used to check model performance

blocks.prompt:
53 Differentiate between training data and validation data.
(Training data aur validation data mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Validation helps detect overfitting and improves evaluation

rows: Model ko patterns sikhata hai
Naye data par karkardagi check karta hai
Model is se seekhta hai
Model is se nahi seekhta
Model fit karne ke liye
Overfitting pakarta aur tuning ki rehnumai karta hai

blocks.prompt:
54 How is hyperparameter tuning done? What is the effect of poor tuning?
(Hyperparameter tuning kaise hoti hai? Kharab tuning ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Model ki settings (hyperparameters) ko mukhtalif values se test kiya jata hai aur validation data tuning ki rehnumai karta hai. Sahi tuning accuracy barhati aur errors kam karti hai; kharab tuning kaar-kardagi kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Parameters are tested with different values

blocks.prompt:
55 Explain hyperparameter tuning with the speaker-volume analogy.
(Speaker ki awaz wali misal se hyperparameter tuning samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat ooonchi awaz bigar jati hai, bohat dheemi sunai nahi deti, sahi level par awaz saaf aur mutawazin hoti hai. Isi tarah ghalat hyperparameters se model kharab chalta hai, aur sahi values se behtar seekhta aur durust nataij deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hyperparameter tuning is like adjusting the volume of a speaker

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between robustness and reliability of a model.
(Model ki robustness aur reliability mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Robustness means a model performs well in different situations

rows: Mukhtalif halaat mein achha chalna
Aik jaise (consistent) nataij dena
Noise sambhalna; chhoti tabdeeli se fail na hona
Systems par bharosa banana
Mukhtalif halaat mein testing se check
Asal duniya ke istemal ke liye ahem

blocks.prompt:
57 What is predictive modeling? Why does it not always explain reasons?
(Predictive modeling kya hai? Yeh hamesha wajah kyun nahi batati?)
blocks.explanation: Predictive modeling data se mustaqbil ke nataij predict karti hai; models purane data ke patterns se andaza lagate hain ke aage kya hoga. Predictions probability (imkaan) par mabni hain, is liye hamesha wajah nahi batatin.

book_ref.quote: Predictive modeling uses data to predict future outcomes

blocks.prompt:
58 Give two fields that use predictive outcomes and write their use.
(Predictive outcomes istemal karne wali do fields aur un ka istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Business: market ya products ki farokht ke trends ki paishgoi.
2. Healthcare: tashkhees (diagnosis) ke liye predictions.

book_ref.quote: Healthcare uses predictions for diagnosis

blocks.prompt:
59 Why is understanding causality important?
(Causality ko samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Causality sabab aur asar ka taluq dikhati hai jis mein aik factor doosre par seedha asar dalta hai. Scientific studies mein waqiat ki asal wajah samajhne ke liye yeh ahem hai, aur yeh faisle behtar karti aur ghalat mafrozon se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: Causal understanding improves decisions and avoids false assumptions

blocks.prompt:
60 Name four areas in which prediction is useful.
(Chaar aise shobay likhein jahan prediction mufeed hai.)
blocks.explanation: Sales forecasting, stock trend analysis, disease risk prediction aur student performance estimation.

book_ref.quote: This makes prediction useful in areas such as sales forecasting, stock trend analysis

blocks.prompt:
